headline: Jacobs Solutions (NYSE:J) Reports Bullish Q4 CY2025
summary: Global professional services company Jacobs Solutions (NYSE:J) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025, with sales up 12.3% year on year to $3.29 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.53 per share was 1.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
